properties.name: Riverside Walk
properties.gainNote: Round-trip ascent derived from the NPS accessibility survey’s 154.2 ft outbound gain and 48.5 ft outbound loss.
properties.access: Begin past the restrooms at Temple of Sinawava. Turn around where the paved path ends, before entering The Narrows.

properties.name: Bear Lake Loop
properties.gainNote: Elevation gain is published by NPS for the loop.
properties.surface: Firm packed gravel, wooden bridges, and log steps
properties.access: Start at the east lakeshore junction, a short walk from Bear Lake Trailhead. The short parking-area approach is outside the loop distance. Check Bear Lake Road access and timed entry with the park.

properties.name: Flattop Mountain
properties.gainNote: NPS publishes 2,849 ft of gain to the destination. Extra ascent on the return is unverified.
properties.surface: Earth in NPS GIS; exposed alpine terrain above treeline
properties.access: Follow the Flattop route from Bear Lake to the Tonahutu/North Inlet junction, then return the same way. Check the park’s trail conditions and Bear Lake Road access.

sourceSegments.name: Bear Lake To Bierstadt Junction Trail
Bear Lake To Bierstadt Junction Trail

properties.name: Hall of Mosses
properties.trailheadName: Hoh Rain Forest · Hall of Mosses trail entrance
properties.gainNote: Elevation gain is published by NPS for the loop.
properties.surface: Compacted gravel with rocky stretches and steps
properties.access: Start near the Hoh Rain Forest Visitor Center. The trail crosses Taft Creek. Check Hoh Road and facility access with the park.

properties.name: Lower Yosemite Fall Trail
properties.trailheadName: Lower Yosemite Fall · east junction near shuttle stop 6
properties.gainNote: The National Park Service publishes about 50 ft of elevation gain for the full loop.
properties.access: Start on the loop near the Lower Yosemite Fall shuttle stop. Follow the path to the footbridge and return on the opposite side of the loop. The shuttle-stop approach is outside the loop.

properties.name: Limberlost Trail
properties.trailheadName: Limberlost parking area · Skyline Drive mile 43
properties.gainNote: The National Park Service publishes 130 ft of elevation gain for the full loop.
properties.access: The mapped trail starts and ends at neighboring access points in the Limberlost parking area. Check Skyline Drive access with the park.

properties.name: Desert Discovery Trail
properties.trailheadName: Desert Discovery Trailhead · Tucson Mountain District
properties.gainNote: The NPS accessibility survey measured 25.8 ft of loop gain, rounded to 26 ft.
properties.access: The mapped trail starts and ends at neighboring access points in the Desert Discovery parking area.
